Same subdued studio lighting from upper left, flat very light cool-grey background #F3F5F7 with faint soft contact shadow, restrained premium 3D educational rendering. Exercise: CABLE CROSSOVER, high-to-low cable fly at near-contracted position. Staggered stance, planted feet, modest forward lean from ankles/hips, spine neutral. Both arms curve in front of lower chest with soft elbow bend; two small single-hand D handles almost meet, one each closed neutral grip. Two taut cables run distinctly outward/upward from handles to high pulleys on the left and right uprights of a simple full cable station. Full stable station, overhead crossmember, weight stacks and both cable routes visible; cables do not pass through arms or torso. Front three-quarter camera showing both chest and machinery contacts. Chest coral only; arms grey.

review.notes: Two handles visibly connected to high pulleys by separate taut cables; staggered planted stance and soft elbows; coral chest only. Handles finish in front of lower torso. Frame visible, with schematic weight-stack routing.
review.independentNotes: Independent review: staggered stance, lightly bent arms finishing toward lower torso, two separate gripped handles and continuous cables to high pulleys; chest highlights.
